name: Macrozooplankton & jellyfish
description: Large drifting zooplankton (2-20 mm) - krill, amphipods and their kin - together with jellyfish. Functional group pooling the source's macrozooplankton and gelatinous-zooplankton compartments; the source measured them separately (jellyfish feed a step higher, on other zooplankton), but both are large-bodied drifters eaten by fish and seabirds, so they are pooled here to fit the 25-node ceiling.
